entries.visual_spec: [blocks/display/chameleon/kb-chunking-3pane-preview] SectionCard !p-0。header border-b border-stone-200/70 px-3 py-2，标题 text-[14px] font-medium + 副标 text-[11px] stone-500 + chunks 计数 + 重跑 RotateCw(pending animate-spin)。grid h-[calc(100vh-180px)] grid-cols-[1fr_1.2fr_320px]。栏头 bg-warm-2/40 border-b px-3 py-1.5 text-[10.5px] uppercase tracking-wider stone-500。左 Textarea border-0 rounded-none font-mono text-[12px]。中 ChunkCard: rounded-md border bg-white px-3 py-2，选中 border-amber-400 ring-2 ring-amber-100 / hover border-stone-300 bg-stone-50，头 text-[10px] uppercase「#seq」+ 「N 字·~M tok」font-mono tnum，正文 text-[12px] whitespace-pre-wrap stone-800。右 mode 按钮 grid-cols-2 gap-1.5 rounded-md border px-2 py-1.5 text-[11.5px]，选中 border-amber-400 bg-amber-50/60 text-amber-800；range input accent-amber-600；CleanRow label + Switch；底部 Sparkles h-3 text-amber-500 + 防抖提示。

[blocks/display/chameleon/kb-hit-test-3pane] grid lg:grid-cols-[260px_minmax(0,1fr)_minmax(0,1.05fr)] gap-3。① 参数: Field label text-[12px] stone-600 + Textarea/range(accent-amber-600)/Select h-8 text-[12.5px]/Switch；搜索 Button w-full + Search h-3.5。② HitCard: block w-full rounded-lg border bg-white p-2.5，active border-amber-300 ring-1 ring-amber-200 / hover border-amber-200，头 text-[11px] stone-500「#rank 文档 seq」font-mono + ScoreBreakdown compact + 正文 line-clamp-2 text-[12px] stone-700。③ SourceView: rounded-lg border border-stone-200/70 bg-white，头 Link 文档名 + seq font-mono text-[10.5px] + ScoreBreakdown 全 + 原文 whitespace-pre-wrap text-[12.5px] + 关键词高亮(dangerouslySetInnerHTML)。空态 SearchX h-8 strokeWidth 1.4 stone-400。

[blocks/display/chameleon/responsive-overlay-data-table] wrapper: relative rounded-lg(8) border border-stone-200/60；overflowX 时 overflow-x-auto 否则 overflow-hidden。table: table-fixed；scrollX&&!minWidth → min-w-max，否则 w-full；minWidth 设 style.minWidth。colgroup: hasLeftBar 首列 col width=4。thead: border-b border-stone-200/70；tr text-[11px](11) font-medium text-stone-400（注意与 waveflow 的 bg-warm-2/40+text-[10.5px] uppercase tracking-wider text-stone-500 不同——本表头无暖底无大写无字距）；th px-3(12) py-2.5(10) font-medium，sortable header <button inline-flex items-center gap-1(4) hover:text-stone-900> + SortIndicator(ArrowUpDown/ArrowUp/ArrowDown h-3 w-3=12，未排序 text-stone-300)。tbody: divide-y divide-stone-100 text-[12.5px](12.5) transition-opacity duration-200；showOverlay 时 pointer-events-none opacity-50。refreshing overlay: 绝对定位 inset-x-0 top-0 z-10 h-[2px](2) overflow-hidden bg-stone-200/30，内层 h-full background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent 0%,#3b82f6 40%,#2563eb 60%,transparent 100%) + animation:global-progress 1.1s ease-in-out infinite。skeleton 行：Array(8)，每 cell px-3 py-3(12)，内 div.skeleton h-2(8) rounded-full style.width=`${40+((i*7+c.key.length)%50)}%`，showSkeleton 时 opacity-100 否则 opacity-0(透明占位防闪)，transition-opacity duration-150。leftBar 列: td relative p-0，内 span absolute inset-y-0 left-0 w-1(4) bg-emerald/red/stone-* 或 bg-transparent。数据行: group transition-colors hover:bg-stone-50；onRowClick 时 cursor-pointer。数据 cell: px-3 py-3。empty: colSpan 全列 py-8 text-center text-stone-400，flex-col items-center gap-2(8) emptyText+emptyExtra。延迟双阈值: useDelayedFlag(isPlaceholder,200,400) 骨架；useDelayedFlag(busy&&!isPlaceholder&&rows>0,250,400) overlay。lucide: ArrowDown/ArrowUp/ArrowUpDown。

[components/typography-atoms/chameleon/hint-column-header] span inline-flex items-center gap-1(4)，title + hint 时 Tooltip 包 HelpCircle h-3 w-3(12) cursor-help text-stone-300 hover:text-stone-500 strokeWidth=1.75。lucide: HelpCircle。

[blocks/display/chameleon/run-compare-heatmap-matrix] 矩阵 table border-collapse text-[11.5px] rounded-lg border border-stone-200。thead bg-stone-50，首列 th min-w-[220px] sticky left-0 z-10 border-r，运行列 th min-w-[116px] + 名称 truncate + 均值 text-[10px] stone-400。行 cursor-pointer hover:bg-stone-50/60，首格 sticky left-0 max-w-[260px] 样本预览 truncate stone-700 + 预期 truncate text-[10px] stone-400。score 格 px-1.5 py-1.5，内块 tnum rounded px-2 py-1 + scoreBg 色阶。对比统计折叠：ChevronDown/Right h-3.5 + 「对比统计」text-[12.5px] font-medium + 副标 stone-400「能力雷达·分数分布·逐题得分·AI 分析」，展开 rounded-lg border bg-white p-3 内含 recharts(雷达/柱/折线，色板 #3b82f6/#10b981/#f59e0b/#8b5cf6/#f43f5e/#06b6d4) + Markdown AI 分析。弹窗 Modal size xl: 问题 + 预期块 rounded-md border-emerald-200/70 bg-emerald-50/40 + OutputBlock(pre max-h-72 bg-stone-50 font-mono text-[11.5px]) + 运行列 grid 每列 rounded-md border bg-white p-2.5 + 得分 chip scoreBg。导出报告头 exporting 态 + pixelRatio 1.5。

[blocks/display/chameleon/trace-observation-tree] 容器 space-y-0.5 font-mono text-[11.5px]。TreeRow: flex items-center gap-2(8) rounded px-1 py-1，paddingLeft=depth*14+4，hover bg-stone-100/70，选中 bg-blue-50 + absolute left-0 w-[3px] rounded-r bg-blue-500 竖条；depth guide: absolute border-l border-stone-200/80 left=(depth-1)*14+10。折叠箭头 Chevron h-3 w-3 stone-400。type icon h-3.5 + 色：trace stone-700/span stone-500/generation violet-600/agent blue-600/tool orange-600/retriever emerald-600/evaluator amber-600/embedding cyan-600/guardrail rose-600。type label w-16 font-medium。失败 AlertCircle h-3 + rose-500 + error 截 40 字。scores chip 按 source: feedback emerald/annotation amber/eval violet/api blue border+50bg+700text；👍👎 ThumbsUp/Down。token Badge outline font-mono text-[10px]。duration: w-32 区，条 h-1 flex-1 rounded-full bg-stone-100 内填(成功 bg-blue-400/失败 bg-rose-400) width=duration/total%，数字 tnum w-12 text-right text-[10.5px] stone-500「Nms」。ObservationIconRail 收起态：纵向 icon 轨 gap-0.5，选中 bg-blue-100。

[blocks/display/chameleon/trace-gantt-timeline] LABEL_W 210 / ROW_H 30 / RULER_H 24。缩放条右上：Minus/Plus h-3.5 rounded p-0.5 hover bg-stone-100 + 百分比 w-10 text-center font-mono text-[10.5px] tabular-nums，步进 *1.5。ruler: label 占位 text-[10.5px] stone-400「时间轴」+ 刻度区 border-b border-stone-200/70，tick font-mono text-[9.5px] stone-400 translateX 同步 scrollLeft。行: border-b border-stone-100，选中 bg-amber-50/60 / hover bg-stone-50。label 列 sticky left-0 z-10 paddingLeft 6+depth*12，type slice(0,4) rounded px-1 font-mono text-[9px] uppercase(成功 bg-stone-100 stone-500/失败 bg-rose-50 rose-600) + agent_key truncate text-[11px] stone-700。GanttBar: h-[14px] rounded-[3px] -translate-y-1/2，OBS_COLOR trace stone-400/span sky-400/generation violet-400/agent indigo-400/tool amber-400/retriever teal-400/evaluator fuchsia-400/embedding cyan-400/guardrail rose-300，失败统一 bg-rose-500；选中 ring-2 ring-stone-800 ring-offset-1，hover brightness-110 ring-1 ring-stone-500；width>12% 内显时长 font-mono text-[9.5px] text-white/90。CostLabel: 有成本 emerald-700 / 仅 token stone-400 font-mono text-[10px] tabular-nums。body 高 min(520,max(180,rows*30+8))。

[blocks/feedback/chameleon/flair-glow-empty-state] 外容器: flex flex-col items-center justify-center text-center；compact 时 gap-1.5(6) py-2 否则 gap-3(12) py-10(40)。flair 模式图标(flair&&!compact): relative grid place-items-center [&>svg]:h-12 [&>svg]:w-12(48)，辉光 span aria-hidden absolute h-20 w-20(80) rounded-full background:radial-gradient(circle, color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-primary-300) 28%, transparent), transparent 65%) + class anim-halo，图标 div.anim-float relative text-primary-500。普通图标: text-stone-300，compact [&>svg]:h-7 [&>svg]:w-7(28) 否则 [&>svg]:h-12 [&>svg]:w-12(48)。title: font-medium text-stone-600，compact text-[12.5px] 否则 text-[14px](14)。description: max-w-sm leading-relaxed text-stone-400，compact text-[11.5px] 否则 text-[12.5px]。action: compact mt-1 否则 mt-2。

[blocks/filters/chameleon/table-toolbar-refresh-leading] 容器: mb-2.5(10) flex items-center gap-2(8)。title: h3 text-[13.5px](13.5) font-semibold text-stone-900。右区: ml-auto flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5(6)。刷新按钮(onRefresh 传时): button flex h-7(28) w-7(28) shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-md(6) text-stone-400 hover:bg-stone-100 hover:text-stone-700，内 RotateCw h-3.5 w-3.5(14)。leadingExtra 槽紧随其后。search: relative，绝对定位搜索按钮 left-1.5 top-1/2 z-10 -translate-y-1/2 rounded p-0.5 text-stone-400 hover:bg-stone-100 内 Search h-3 w-3(12)；Input !h-7(28) pl-6(24) text-[12px](12) maxWidth=search.width??180，Enter 提交。filter: Select，SelectTrigger !h-7 whitespace-nowrap !text-[12px] width=f.width??110(110)，内 span.truncate；SelectContent 首项 SelectItem value=all。extra 槽收尾。lucide: RotateCw/Search。

[blocks/form/chameleon/generation-panel] 容器 space-y-3。chip(风格/比例): rounded-full border px-2.5 py-1 text-[11.5px]; active→border-violet-500(#8b5cf6) bg-violet-50 text-violet-700; idle→border-stone-200 text-stone-600 hover:border-stone-300。Label text-[12px] text-stone-600。首帧上传: 占位 h-24 w-32(=96×128) rounded-md border border-dashed border-stone-300 text-stone-400 hover:border-stone-400, ImagePlus h-5 w-5 或 Loader2 animate-spin; 已传 img h-24 w-auto rounded-md border + 右上 -top-2 -right-2 h-5 w-5 rounded-full bg-stone-700 text-white X 删除。Textarea/Input/Select 均 text-[12px] h-8(=32)。自定义宽高: 两 number Input + ×分隔 + text-[10.5px] text-stone-400「px({lo}–{hi})」。seed: number Input + h-8 w-8 rounded-md border 骰子按钮(Dices h-3.5 w-3.5)。高级折叠: border-t border-stone-100 pt-2, 触发 text-[11.5px] text-stone-500「▾ 收起高级参数 / ▸ 高级参数」。lucide: Dices/ImagePlus/Loader2/X。
